steps: Transpose original ten sample columns to ten sample rows; preserve all counts and taxon labels.
Remove legacy row-attribute prefixes from transposed taxon column labels to avoid interpreting them as column types in PAST; preserve all count values.
Use the documented modern PAST colon-format, two header rows and explicit Group datatype. Group was verified visually on import; legacy numeric prefixes were not used for the accepted analysis.
Add synthetic group column: samples1..5=A,6..10=B, solely for numerical validation; no biological group hypothesis.
p_value_check: Stochastic native output retained; deterministic F and sums of squares compared to export precision. No identical-PRNG p-value equality claim.
retained_initial_input: input-with-legacy-attributes.dat (not used for numerical capture: imported attribute prefixes mapped to column types)
